cactus-needle (this npm package) is an independent browser and Node.js wrapper for Needle 3 and Whistle.
It is not an official Cactus Compute package.

The files vendor/needle.cjs and vendor/needle.wasm are from Cactus Compute's
Cactus-Compute/needle3 repository on Hugging Face,
revision 2ae11323dc000f5e70c49f7403efa6af12ba9e67.
The loader is renamed from needle.js to needle.cjs; its contents are unchanged.
They are distributed under Apache License 2.0; see vendor/LICENSE.
Source URLs and SHA-256 checksums are recorded in vendor/manifest.json.
vendor/manifest.json is supplied by this wrapper.

dist/browser/worker.js bundles the loader for the browser using tsdown's
CommonJS interop and minification. Node.js branches are removed in that bundle.
The vendored loader and WASM binary are unchanged.

Model weights are downloaded separately from Cactus-Compute/needle3 and
Cactus-Compute/whistle on Hugging Face and are not included in the npm package.
Their Apache License 2.0 also applies
when redistributing those weights.
